manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the gum bottle on the red card.

Task description: The target is the green-and-white gum bottle. In the head camera view, it is below and left of the red card. Move the bottle onto the red card on the table.

Success criteria: Pick up the gum bottle and place it on the red card so it actually contacts the card and is supported by the table. After the gripper releases, the bottle must remain on the card.

## Execution tips

- Use both finger pads to grasp opposite sides of a relatively straight section of the bottle below the cap. Leave clearance between the fingertips and table, avoiding a grasp only on the cap edge or contact with the table.
- Set the gripper opening to the bottle width with a small margin. Before closing, use the available view to confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides rather than merely overlapping in the image and toppling the bottle from one side.
- Lift slightly to check whether the bottle moves with the gripper without sliding down. Keep it upright and its base off the table during transport where possible to reduce slipping and dragging.
- When placing, aim the bottle bottom toward the inside of the card, away from its edge. Lower slightly near the table and release only after the bottom is supported, avoiding unsupported release or the fingertips brushing the card.
